Meet Idol's Nails

Full-service nail salon and spa

Idol's Nails

Idol's Nails is a full-service nail salon and spa located on W Main St in Lansdale. Offering a variety of services including UV gel nails, Shellac gel manicures, waxing, facials, eyelash extensions, and tinting, the salon caters to both individuals and groups for special occasions such as weddings and birthdays.

The salon provides a personalized experience with a focus on quality and customer satisfaction. From nail art to spa pedicures, every service is designed to leave you feeling beautiful and relaxed.

Parties of six or more

The salon hosts wedding and birthday parties with refreshments for groups of six or more. Call to plan yours.

More than nails

Waxing, facials, eyelash extensions and tinting are all on the menu alongside the nail services.

On W Main Street
